policy: split first by independent founding block and by WHOLE intervention family; never by timepoint, cell, arm or nearby sample. No trajectory straddles roles.

FORMULATION_TRAIN.used_for: the branch-endpoint feasibility probe and the intervention-responsiveness probe
FORMULATION_TRAIN.families: F1-F5, all used only to test responsiveness, never to fit a model

MODEL_SELECTION_VALIDATION.used_for: never opened - the stop fired before model selection

UNTOUCHED_PILOT_EVALUATION.reason: the endpoint failed its feasibility gate, so allocating and locking an evaluation set would have burned independent blocks for nothing
